findings.quote: AI is already transforming knowledge, work, our economies, education and information.
findings.rationale: Frames AI transformation as requiring collective decisions for the common good and anticipatory governance.

findings.quote: Therefore, Benin is in favor of international AI governance that's inclusive, responsible, and development-oriented.
findings.rationale: Calls for inclusive AI governance and African design and production capacity, balancing development applications against dependency on external data, compute and technology.
